# AppleSiliconDDC

Minimal source snapshot of [waydabber/AppleSiliconDDC](https://github.com/waydabber/AppleSiliconDDC)
at revision [`67ff964ab8123d9d35fadf7d8e1a7c677d31da14`](https://github.com/waydabber/AppleSiliconDDC/commit/67ff964ab8123d9d35fadf7d8e1a7c677d31da14).

The Swift library, its Objective-C bridging header and module map are copied
unchanged. The upstream ASDDC executable, repository metadata, build products
and unrelated sources are not included. This library uses private IOAVService
and CoreDisplay interfaces on Apple Silicon.

Copyright and permission terms are in [LICENSE](LICENSE). The license is also
included in the built EyeSaver application.
